title: A plan of any shape → client · server · contract
lede: The plan below is `apps/outline.bl`: a tree, walked by recursion the compiler proved finite.
hints: The snapshot type is **recursive**: `:item` holds `[:list 16 :item]`. Every walk over it — the view `item-row`, the roll-up `tally`, the search `prune`, the checks `find-item` and `depth-of` — calls itself only on a child, and the build proves it: look for `recursion: structural`.

Fold, expand and search run in your browser with no network. Adding a step, ticking a phase (which ticks everything inside it) and removing a branch go to the server, which rebuilds the path down to that one item.
Try it: make `item-row` recurse on `it` instead of `k` and rebuild — the build refuses and names the cycle `item-row → fn → item-row`.
